How it works

01. Connect

Connect a browser wallet, then switch to Sepolia when prompted.

02. Pick a Block

Choose a mined block from #1 to #10,000. Check the chain height for availability.

03. Mint & View

Mint your block data card, then view it in the gallery. Each card shows round, work, and rarity.

Why collect?

Early Blocks = Legendary

Blocks #1–#10 are Legendary. #11–#100 are Epic. Rarity comes from the block number, not when you mint.

Fully On-Chain

The card’s SVG art is generated on-chain. The website is a separate static export prepared for IPFS.

Milestone Blocks

Every 1,000th block is a Milestone. Every 100th is Notable. These special blocks mark key moments in the hamster's journey.

Free to Mint

Only pay Sepolia gas. No mint fee. Connect your wallet, pick a block, mint. Grab some Sepolia ETH from a faucet and start collecting.
